crop.notes: Clipping is the headline deck and the 'Turf Scandal' (John G. Blow / Bill Bass) story. Allen appears only in one deck line, 'O'Leary Pays His Respects to Tom Allen.' The O'Leary item itself ('Pedestrianism. Tom Allen Acts the Dog', top of column 6 on page 3) is not in the clipping.

ocr.notes: Transcript matches the clipping, which is the horse-racing story, not the Allen item.

summary.suggested: The St. Louis Globe-Democrat reported that champion pedestrian Daniel O'Leary, arriving in Chicago, said Tom Allen had sneered at and insulted him in London during the last hundred miles of his walk.

metadata.notes: Masthead: St. Louis Daily Globe-Democrat, Sunday Morning, May 19, 1878, page 3. Same page and story as article 615 (likely duplicate).

notes: Probable duplicate of 615: same page, same O'Leary item. This clipping holds only the headline deck. Re-crop to the Pedestrianism item or merge with 615. Facts are recorded on 615. Focus here is passing because the clipping only names Allen in the deck.
